people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
translations.bsb: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
translations.kjv: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
